title: Jim W NDE 282
content: While being transported to Harborview Hospital via helicopter, I found myself floating above my body and looking down at it through the air-grill that lined the radius at the roof line of the interior of the helicopter. I felt very comfortable during this and at peace somewhat. I also felt the presence of an indescribable light behind me. I did not want to turn to this light, maybe from fear of not returning. My fear was not of the light itself, in any way. I don't know how long this out of body took place. I remember the emergency medical technicians rushing around, fixing my busted up torso and head, and saying twice, ' We're losing him.' After some time I felt what I know was the hand of God on my shoulder, and a very calming voice. If I may quote the Lord, 'You are not done here.' I felt a gentle push on my shoulders and was pushed back into my beaten body. I remember nothing after that point, and until I left the coma, I had slipped into. What I do remember is the absolute presence of God. A gentle effective, push from behind was felt. I wasn't done here. The next thing that I remember was coming around in the hospital, still not knowing anything, except that my body was really messed up. I wish that was all that had happened, but the real damage wasn't obvious or seen for some time. My journey, at this point, has just begun.

out_of_body.vantage_other_detail: Floating above his body in a helicopter, looking down at it through the air-grill lining the roof interior.

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: Felt a gentle push on the shoulders and was 'pushed back into my beaten body.'
boundary_and_return.mission_detail: He was told, "You are not done here."

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Severely injured ('busted up torso and head') and transported by helicopter to Harborview Hospital; later in coma.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: He perceived EMTs saying twice, "We're losing him." He felt "the hand of God" and heard, "You are not done here."
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE occurred during helicopter transport; presence of light behind him; then communication/command to return and being pushed back into body; no tunnel, no life review, no described other realm.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: He viewed his body through the helicopter's interior roof air-grill while floating above it; he refused to turn toward the light out of concern about not returning.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "We're losing him." / "You are not done here."
